rule_title: TTP T1070.006 - System Time Manipulated by Non-NTP Process: Large Clock Jump (EID 4616)
description: Detects EID 4616 where the system clock is changed by more than a trivial amount by a non-system, non-NTP process. Legitimate clock changes come from LOCAL SERVICE via svchost.exe (W32tm NTP sync) and are typically sub-second corrections. An attacker using PowerShell, cmd.exe, or any non-system binary to jump the clock by minutes or hours indicates deliberate timestamp manipulation — used to forge Kerberos tickets with future validity windows, bypass time-based lockout policies, or corrupt forensic timelines. The ProcessName filter excluding svchost.exe eliminates the high-volume NTP noise while preserving all malicious changes.
